name: HIVE Valenzuela Facility
notes: SEC filing defines the Valenzuela Facility as a 100 MW hydroelectric data center near Valenzuela, Paraguay, and says Phase 3 at Valenzuela was completed as of 2025-11-10. Baxtel places the Bitcoin mining data center in Valenzuela, Cordillera.

name: Cademot S.A. Valenzuela cryptomining server farm
notes: Investigative report says two large cryptomining farms were under construction near the Valenzuela 500 kV substation in Cordillera, one by W3X S.A. and one by Cademot S.A.; it reports the cryptominer has 132,000 kW of ANDE contracted power. W3X appears tied to HIVE Valenzuela, so it is not separately counted here.

name: Delta Mining Paraguay Ayolas Bitcoin data center
notes: El Clip/El Surti report describes a Bitcoin farm in the Cristo Rey neighborhood of Ayolas, a city in Misiones department, operated by Delta Mining Paraguay S.A., subsidiary of Delta Mining LLC; the company describes itself as bitcoin mining and data center colocation, with an ANDE contract for 5,500 kW.

name: MITIC Data Center Modular del Estado, Chaco'i
developer: Consorcio TIC (Concret Mix S.A., ITC Servicios S.R.L., TSV del Paraguay S.R.L.)
notes: MITIC awarded the turnkey Tier III modular state data center to Consorcio TIC. ABC reports the site will be on MITIC land in Nueva Asuncion, Presidente Hayes, in the Chaco'i area; execution term reported as 20 months.
